Game Overview

Boontz! is a adventure title where guide Penguin Dad through charming retro landscapes, using Magic Frosty Power to maneuver ice blocks in clever puzzles. With intuitive controls and increasing challenges, explore 22 levels, unlocking paths and reuniting with Penguin Family. Delight in enchanting visuals and joyous music as you strategize through this captivating journey.
